Native Terror stores fixed origin and applies its own difficulty divisor. Howl must not call the ordinary Necromancer player-class formula path blindly; target tracking, generic curse duration/difficulty and supported native species/control need verification.

AI initialization records the caster target override; initial escape clears it. Later common target acquisition can choose another threat. Current permanent-caster/fixed-origin fear behavior is not complete source equivalence.

Generic curse leading gates apply curse resistance/Attract protection. Even failed curse allocation is followed by transient target/AI switching in the helper. Source dead checks belong to the caller before separate AI eligibility.
Source target distance uses weighted integer axis distance and target full-size subtraction;147 compiled raw-coordinate cases establish that contract before native tile projection.
